title: Appraisal Order Turn Time and Service Level Schedule
content:
The service levels below apply to Appraisal Order report types placed through Larkspur's appraisal management partners. Business-day figures are whole business days; the hold limit is in calendar days.

| Report type | Standard turn time (business days from order to promised delivery) | Rush turn time (business days) | Assignment of an appraiser (business days) | Inspection scheduled after assignment (business days) | Hold limit before cancellation (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 3 | 3 | 1 | 2 | 30 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 5 | 3 | 1 | 2 | 30 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 7 | 4 | 1 | 2 | 30 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 7 | 4 | 1 | 2 | 30 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 8 | 5 | 1 | 2 | 30 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 10 | 6 | 1 | 2 | 30 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 12 | 8 | 1 | 2 | 30 |

### Notes

- **Standard turn time** is the number of business days from the order to the promised delivery of the completed report at standard speed.
- **Rush turn time** is the number of business days from order to promised delivery when rush is bought. For the Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop), where rush is not offered, the rush figure equals the standard figure of 3.
- **Assignment** — the appraisal management company assigns an appraiser within 1 business day for every report type.
- **Inspection scheduling** — the inspection is to be scheduled within 2 business days after assignment for every report type.
- **Hold limit** — an order may stay on hold for 30 calendar days before it is cancelled, for every report type.

The difference between standard and rush turn time, in business days: 2 for the Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055), 3 for the Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073), the Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) and the Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA), and 4 for the Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) and the Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo).
